errors.evidence: The description states the starting memory for the VideoLLAVA series is 20-30 GB, but the first data point for this series (purple line) is below 20 GB, at approximately 18 GB.

The description states that the VideoLLAVA series goes beyond the top of the y-range (400 GB) by roughly 320 frames. However, the plot shows the line exceeding 400 GB at a much lower frame count, well before 300 frames (approximately at 280 frames).
